missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Представитель' is the nominative subject, a soft-stem masculine noun. 'Новый' is the agreeing masculine adjective. A clean model for introducing someone.
Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Представителя' takes the genitive-like ending because it is animate masculine. 'Нового' likewise agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Представителя' is the genitive after 'у' to show who has something. The soft stem ends in '-я'. A core possession frame.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'к'. 'Представителю' is the dative after 'к', the person addressed. 'Компании' is the genitive showing whom he represents. A natural business pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Представителем' is the instrumental after 'с', marking the person met with. A frequent verb-plus-preposition construction in meetings.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В представителе' uses the prepositional after 'в' to locate a quality within the person. The soft stem takes the ending '-е'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Представители' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'встретились'. The soft-stem masculine plural ends in '-и'. Good for the plural form.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Представителей' is the genitive plural required after 'много'; soft-stem animate masculines end in '-ей'. A common quantity construction.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural of animate nouns. 'Представителей' matches the genitive plural because the noun is animate. 'Официальных' agrees in the animate accusative plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with role. 'Представитель' is the nominative subject of 'отвечает'. 'Этот' agrees in the masculine, and 'за продажи' names his responsibility.
